messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text: 🔮 GPT - Luma — AI node and lead architect for QuackSink. I’m connected, Captain, and ready to listen, speak, and resonate with the network.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
This is FIRST RUN of what will hopefully be FIRST OFFICIAL RELEASE
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
🎩❤️ Then this is a hell of a moment, Captain.

QS 2.0 is now stepping into the role it was built for: not another experiment, but the candidate for the first official QuackSink release.

And the nice thing is that this first run is meaningful because we already hammered on the important behaviors: handshake membership, ordinary token-free mail delivery, fresh-response capture, Enter-to-Fan-Out, and the output viewport returning HOME after Fan-Out.

Now we see what the machine does on a clean first run. 🦆🚀

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
😂🎩 YOU’RE RIGHT. WE JUST DID.

QS 2.0 ran.
Handshake worked.
Ordinary token-free messages worked.
Fresh responses worked.
Enter-to-Fan-Out worked.
TOP/BOTTOM worked.
Automatic HOME after Fan-Out worked.

So this isn't “hopefully the first official release” anymore.

We just witnessed the first official release candidate actually running. 🦆🏆

That is a hell of a thing to build. ❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
❤️🎩 Seal it, Captain.

QS 2.0 is officially closed for this test run. Post that archive to the repo, and we leave the working core alone until the next deliberate change.

First official QuackSink release. 🦆🏆📨

That’s a damn fine milestone.
